cases.name: Amber Renee Archuleta
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Amber was shy and yet was outgoing with a spunky personality.  She enjoyed giving her friends and family a serious yet playful attitude.  Amber was a talented artist, and her artwork is displayed at the Questa Library.  She taught herself to play the guitar and was an avid Denver Bronco’s fan.  She enjoyed playing basketball on the court and off the court, at her grandmother’s home, or anywhere else.  Amber attended Questa schools and this year she would have been in the 8th grade.  She had many friends which she supported through good and bad times.  Amber will truly be missed by everyone.  Rest in peace sweet angel, we love you very much."
cases.narrative: According to the police report, four kids were listening to music at a home when a 14-year-old boy took out a gun and shot her. The teenager then took the body of the girl outside before his father came home.
